prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for all specific kinds of changes, as each category currently has only one test.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to measured, noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +4.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: -0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Postpone Account Sign In After Adoption: Move the mandatory sign-in step until after users select and customize their desktop pet so they experience initial value first. (why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users before they even see or customize their pet, creating unnecessary friction too early.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Customization Preview Stage Screen: Insert a stage-layout preview screen right after pet choice to display real-time companion visual rendering before photo confirmation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results, and adoption drops 39.1% of users.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Guided Desktop Launch Flow: Add a new checklist setup screen prior to final home onboarding to guide users through desktop permissions and interaction controls. (why: 3 users reported desktop visibility issues and 3 reported confusion regarding how to control or talk to pets after onboarding.)
3: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Tip Carousel: Add an interactive tip carousel and estimated time indicator on the waiting screen during pet generation. (why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s and loses 18.7% of users who leave during generation.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Safeguard Hint: Add a prominent sync hint explaining how signing in protects existing desktop pets and prevents progress resets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
5: [home, notification] Background Pet Preparation Notification Toggle: Enable desktop notification alerts on the waiting screen so users know they can minimize the app while generation finishes. (why: Mean waiting time is over 38 minutes (2336s); desktop alerts let users multitask without abandoning setup.)
6: [choose_path, incentive] Customization Path Selection Highlight: Display visual benefit badges on path options to clarify quick start vs full customization choices. (why: Choose path drops 19.6% of users with a high mean time of 514s due to decision hesitation.)
7: [adoption, copy] Simplified Photo Upload Instructions: Revise the photo upload headline and body copy to specify clear lighting and photo angle requirements. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted companion rendering.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Story Scroll Path Welcome Layout: Update the story screen to a story_scroll layout with a visible step counter to guide first-time users smoothly. (why: The initial story step takes a mean of 514s; structured scrolling provides clearer pacing.)

scores.note: Sign-in loses 27.1% early; deferring friction lets users see value first, though moving flow requires a release.
Adoption has highest drop (39.1%) & 3 tickets, but inserting new screens previously degraded conversion (-3.0%).
Finish loses 35.2% with 6 total support complaints, but adding new flow screens risks adding friction.
Home step loses 18.7% during 38 min wait; info carousel aids perception without support mail backing.
Strong evidence (8 support emails + 27.1% sign-in drop) and cheap config, but previous sign_in hint tested negative (-0.9%).
Addresses extreme mean wait time (2336s) by enabling multitasking, but requires native notification integration.
Low cost config update; choose_path previously responded best to updates (+4.2%), though evidence is funnel-only.
Addresses 39.1% drop and 3 generation failure tickets via simple copy tweak; low risk and config-only.
Targeted at 514s delay in choose_path; redesigns on this step showed positive lift previously (+4.2%).
